title: Deep hole drilling (tube sheet)
description: Deep hole drilling (tube sheet) capability for titanium components
processDescription: Laser drilling of titanium uses pulsed laser energy to create precise holes through percussion or trepanning methods. Hole diameters range from 0.05 mm to 3 mm with aspect ratios up to 20:1, specifically for tube. Deep tube for Chemical, Aerospace, Medical present unique challenges: Wall thickness uniformity (±0.05 mm) over long lengths. Internal surface finish Ra < 0.8 µm for fluid flow. Bent tube ovality control.
heatControl: Pulsed fiber laser with nitrogen assist gas. Pulse energy and frequency controlled to minimize recast layer.
flatnessControl: Non-contact process; no mechanical distortion. Vacuum fixturing for thin foil.
capabilitiesDescription: Integrated manufacturing capability for Deep hole drilling (tube sheet), supported by in-house QC, material certification, and engineering review.
